caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, floor-length dress with a high collar. The main body of the dress is olive green, including the voluminous skirt and the majority of the bodice. The chest, collar, and cuffs feature lighter green or possibly white panels decorated with a subtle floral or lace-like pattern. The sleeves are puffed at the shoulders and taper down towards the cuffs, which are the same lighter, patterned fabric. There is a visible vertical seam or trim running down the center of the bodice and skirt. To the upper right of the main colored illustration, there is a black and white line sketch of the same dress, showing its back view and construction details. In the bottom right corner, there is printed and handwritten text that reads "Federal Art Project-W.P.A. of Va. by Mary Humes." The background is plain and off-white.
title: Dress
